observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Indoor stage or dance battle venue surrounded by a seated crowd of spectators holding cameras and phones
observation.dancers: Multiple dancers performing solo turns in front of a crowd, primarily male soloists
observation.formation_and_space: Soloist in the center of an open circular performance floor surrounded by spectators
observation.posture: Upright torso, slightly bent knees, weight shifting between feet with robotic precision and stiffness
observation.footwork: Stepping, sliding, and pivoting on the beat with sharp, halting movements; some rapid foot shuffles cannot be fully detailed due to video framing and resolution
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms bent at the elbows with hands held up, moving in angular, rigid, segmented paths with sudden stops
observation.hips_and_torso: Controlled isolations, subtle chest pops, and occasional mechanical body waves
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low drops to one knee and quick recovery back to standing, sharp turns
observation.costume_and_props: Casual modern streetwear: jackets, dark trousers, white sneakers, and t-shirts
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and rapid micro-movements of feet and hands are partially obscured by camera angle and lighting contrast

signature_moments.what: Dancer stands upright performing sharp, segmented robotic arm and head hits on the beat
Dancer drops down to one knee with rigid control and holds position before rising sharply
Dancer executes rapid mechanical stepping and pivoting with frozen upper body poses
